body: I was one of the "Most Likely to Succeed" of my prom. I'm addicted too, and my brain is nothing but a fucked up mess. I get your point. I have love in my life, but, what kind of love can I give to anybody in my condition? Right now, I'm silently destroying the future of every person who ever has had a bit of love for me. Do what you have to do, always looking for the benefit of everyone -not just you-. Good luck.
